lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce legal department overhaul raises questions as development decisions loom
lead_independence.lead: The uncertainty follows the City Commission's decision not to renew City Attorney Sara Hedges' contract. At the same time, Assistant City Attorney Felicia Holloman has resigned, and temporary attorney Caroline Valentin is set to leave at the end of the month, leaving the city searching for new legal leadership. Commissioners voted 3-2 to move forward with appointing Deputy City Manager Camille Wallace as interim city attorney while a search is conducted for a permanent replacement.
